title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Trying to Focus 😂 Sitting Down to Work #shorts
desc:
ADHD trying to focus: one task, one desk, one whole day.

Sat down at 9. Opened the laptop at 5. 😂 What's YOUR first distraction? 👇

Tip: set a 10-minute timer and start ugly. The setup can wait.

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdbrain #adhdproblems #adhdhumor #shorts #relatable #funny
tags: how to focus when you have adhd
what it's like to have adhd

beats.say: Here's how a normal person sits down to work. Sit. Open the laptop. Work.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:

beats.say: Now here's me. Alright. Let's sit down and do some work. Today is the day.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: But first, water. You can't focus thirsty.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: And a snack. Brain food. That's science.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Okay, I can't work at a messy desk. Let me just clean it real quick.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Now I need the right playlist. Not that one. Not that one either.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Ooh. A video on how octopuses sleep.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Okay. Laptop's open. Let's go. Wait. It's five o'clock?
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I didn't do the work. But I know how octopuses sleep. And the desk is clean.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Here's why. Starting is the hardest part for an ADHD brain, so it hunts for a warm-up that never ends. Set a ten minute timer and start ugly. The setup can wait.
What's your first distraction when you sit down to work? Tell me in the comments.
